mapSynchronization.rule: The production model owns the complete working profile. Surface changes replace only its map block under dirty suppression because the surface controller already marked the shared lifecycle dirty.
mapSynchronization.fullReplacement: Import recovery new-record and full profile replacement update both controllers.
mapSynchronization.canonicalSource: Canonical build reads the synchronized profile from the production model.

editingRules: Map cells remain exclusive to the surface-grid editor.
Derived fields are read-only and rebuilt before canonical save or export.
Generated downstream exports are not manually editable.
Stable record IDs are read-only after creation.
New IDs are deterministic within each collection.
Referenced records cannot be removed until references are repaired.
Field locks disable only affected controls.
Imported values are rendered as text or form values rather than interpreted markup.
lifecycleRules: One scalar panel submission uses one atomic field batch.
Each record add update or removal uses one model event.
Same-task events produce one shared lifecycle dirty mark and one adapter callback.
Profile replacement and canonical rebuild do not mark dirty.
activationGate: P0 browser receipt passes and P1 becomes required-next
Panel files load after domain and transformer dependencies
Surface and production controllers synchronize without duplicate dirty marks
Panel validation joins the blocking P1 workflow
Prepared profile cases pass Chromium interaction tests
